name: Field service coordinator
summary: Runs the office side of trades and home services: quotes, job checklists, reminders and customer messages. Stops arguments about what was included.

changelog.note: First release: role knowledge with 28 sources (Jobber, ServiceTitan and Housecall Pro help pages, US, UK and EU consumer rules), four skills (quotes and scope, scheduling and dispatch, job sheets and handover, customer messages), six prompts, three workflows, training interview and test briefs, and access levels per tool.
